notes.subject: גורו
notes.rationale: 'Be afraid' (גור I) vs many versions 'assemble yourselves' (גור II, sojourn/gather); fear fits the SDBH sense.

notes.subject: חרב / עונות חרב
notes.rationale: חרב appears twice — the sword you flee and the sword of wrath's iniquities — the echo is deliberate and untranslatable.

notes.subject: שדין
notes.rationale: Ketiv שדין read as שֶׁדִּין 'a judgment' (qere שדון); some render 'there is a Judge' or read demons (שדים).

notes.subject: ⟨there is⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew has no copula; שדין is a noun phrase asserted as existing.

notes.subject: to the friends
notes.rationale: Job's closing warning addressed directly to his three friends.

translation: Be afraid for yourselves before the sword, for wrath — iniquities of a sword — ‖ that you may know ⟨there is⟩ a judgment.
